description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from virus-host protein interaction studies generated by affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry (AP-MS) during viral infection.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or interaction observation. Example: 'VH_APMS_0001'.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study or experiment series.

virus_name.descr: Common name of the virus studied. Example: 'SARS-CoV-2', 'Influenza A virus'.

virus_species.descr: Taxonomic species name of the virus, if available.

virus_strain.descr: Virus strain, isolate, or variant designation. Example: 'Wuhan-Hu-1', 'PR8'.

virus_protein_or_gene_target.descr: Viral protein, polyprotein region, or gene product used as bait or focus of the interaction study. Example: 'Spike', 'NS1', 'ORF8'.

host_species.descr: Host species studied. Example: 'Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus'.

host_cell_line.descr: Host cell line used for infection and/or affinity purification. Example: 'HEK293T', 'A549', 'Vero E6'.

host_tissue_or_primary_cell_type.descr: Host tissue or primary cell type, if not a transformed cell line. Example: 'primary human airway epithelial cells'.

host_genotype_or_modification.descr: Host genotype, engineered background, knockout, knockdown, or overexpression status relevant to the experiment.

infection_status.descr: Infection condition for the record. Example values: 'infected', 'mock-infected', 'co-infected'.

infection_time_post_infection_h.descr: Time after infection at which the sample was collected, in hours post infection (hpi).

multiplicity_of_infection.descr: Multiplicity of infection (MOI) used for infection, if applicable.

infection_dose_unit.descr: Unit or basis used to report inoculum dose, if not MOI. Example: 'PFU/cell', 'TCID50/cell'.

virus_entry_or_infection_method.descr: Method used to introduce the virus. Example: 'adsorption', 'transfection', 'electroporation', 'pseudovirus infection'.

sample_material.descr: Biological material analyzed. Example: 'whole cell lysate', 'nuclear extract', 'membrane fraction'.

bait_type.descr: Type of affinity bait used in the AP experiment. Example values: 'viral protein', 'host protein', 'tagged construct', 'endogenous'.

bait_identifier.descr: Specific bait protein identifier or construct name used for affinity purification.

bait_tag.descr: Affinity or epitope tag used on the bait, if any. Example: 'FLAG', 'HA', 'GFP', 'Strep'.

affinity_purification_method.descr: Purification strategy used to isolate complexes. Example: 'co-immunoprecipitation', 'FLAG pull-down', 'Strep-Tactin affinity purification'.

crosslinking_used.descr: Whether a crosslinking step was applied before purification.

crosslinker_name.descr: Name of crosslinking reagent used, if applicable. Example: 'DSP', 'formaldehyde'.

lysis_buffer.descr: Description of lysis buffer composition or name used during sample preparation.

wash_conditions.descr: Description of wash stringency and buffer conditions used during affinity purification.

elution_method.descr: Method used to elute bound complexes from the affinity matrix. Example: 'competitive elution', 'boiling in SDS sample buffer'.

mass_spectrometry_instrument.descr: MS instrument model used for data acquisition. Example: 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos'.

ms_proteomics_workflow.descr: Brief description of the proteomics workflow. Example: 'bottom-up shotgun proteomics'.

protein_database_used.descr: Sequence database used for peptide identification. Example: 'UniProt human + virus proteome'.

search_software.descr: Software used for peptide-spectrum matching. Example: 'MaxQuant', 'Mascot', 'Proteome Discoverer'.

search_version.descr: Version of the search software used.

quantification_method.descr: Protein quantification approach used. Example: 'label-free quantification', 'TMT', 'SILAC'.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize quantitative MS values, if applicable.

interaction_calling_method.descr: Computational or statistical method used to define protein interactions. Example: 'SAINT', 'MiST', 'compPASS'.

interaction_confidence_score.descr: Confidence score or probability assigned to the interaction by the analysis pipeline.

interaction_threshold.descr: Threshold used to call a protein interaction as high-confidence or significant.

control_type.descr: Type of control used for comparison. Example: 'empty tag', 'mock-infected', 'IgG control'.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for this record.

observed_host_protein_name.descr: Name of the host protein detected as a putative interactor.

observed_host_protein_id.descr: Stable identifier for the host protein. Example: UniProt accession or gene ID.

observed_viral_protein_name.descr: Name of the viral protein involved in the interaction, if the record is pairwise.

observed_viral_protein_id.descr: Stable identifier for the viral protein. Example: UniProt/RefSeq or gene ID.

interaction_type.descr: Interaction category inferred or annotated. Example values: 'direct', 'indirect', 'complex-associated'.

functional_annotation.descr: Short functional note on the interaction or biological role. Example: 'innate immune evasion', 'vesicle trafficking'.

pathway_or_process.descr: Host pathway or biological process implicated by the interaction. Example: 'ubiquitination', 'translation', 'autophagy'.

subcellular_localization.descr: Observed or inferred subcellular location of the interaction complex. Example: 'cytoplasm', 'nucleus', 'ER membrane'.

evidence_level.descr: Evidence category supporting the interaction. Example values: 'MS-only', 'orthogonally validated', 'literature-supported'.

orthogonal_validation_used.descr: Whether an additional validation method was used beyond AP-MS.

validation_method.descr: Orthogonal validation method, if used. Example: 'reciprocal co-IP', 'immunoblot', 'proximity ligation assay'.

validation_result.descr: Outcome of the validation experiment. Example values: 'confirmed', 'not confirmed', 'partial confirmation'.

antiviral_relevance.descr: Whether the interaction is proposed as relevant for antiviral targeting or drug development.

therapeutic_target_priority.descr: Priority category for follow-up as a therapeutic target. Example values: 'high', 'medium', 'low'.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the publication associated with the record, if available.

dataset_accession.descr: Repository accession for the underlying proteomics or interaction dataset, if available. Example: PRIDE, MassIVE, ProteomeXchange accession.

comments.descr: Free-text notes relevant to record interpretation, caveats, or deviations from protocol.
